notes: Date now has its own Style section and editor cadence family.
Renderer emits labeled native date inputs, separator, local clear action, invalid status text, and a screen-reader contract for YYYY-MM-DD/native picker limitations.
Frontend sync marks active/invalid date ranges, exposes the clear action, normalizes inverted From/To before applying, and formats active chips as From/To text.
FilterResolver normalizes inverted date bounds for regular Date filters and explicit date between compares.
Guilherme owns visual/browser QA for native picker behavior, labels, inverted state, clear action, active chip text, mobile stacking, and browser differences.
